description: Ours on Serving, the chained toy's interface over the 3D scene: the planner arm of the first-decision check that showed Serving decides exactly as the toy (Curtis A* at 1,000 nodes, observation weight 0.3, planning past the session, every skill's cost learned). The cost file is the toy's: only the two resets are priced, the human's at H = 0.3 and the robot's at --robot-reset-price (0.15 by default) through the toy's own robot_step function. Step protocol only: give --practice-step-budget, --practice-episode-budget and --practice-try-skills sweep3 gather.
